"""M1-T27 intent: a non-finite number stops the run as `failed` (PL-02.train_loop, TRAIN-01).

The world is the contract's replay double of a snake episode; the learner is a Learner double
that raises `NonFiniteError(nan)` (or an interrupt) on its 700th observed transition. With a
budget of 6,000 steps the checkpoints fall every 600 steps, so the last good one is 10%.
"""

import contextlib
import importlib.util
import json
import math
import sys
from dataclasses import replace
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import numpy as np
import pytest

from rllab.core import Array, RunConfig
from rllab.methods import NonFiniteError, Transition
from rllab.runlog import RunRecord
from rllab.train.loop import train_loop

CONTRACTS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "contracts"
FAIL_AT = 700
BUDGET = 6000  # checkpoints every 10% = 600 steps
LAST_GOOD = "ckpt_10.pt"  # the 600-step checkpoint


def _kit() -> Any:
    if "contracts_kit" not in sys.modules:
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("contracts_kit", CONTRACTS / "kit.py")
        assert spec is not None
        assert spec.loader is not None
        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        sys.modules["contracts_kit"] = module
        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return sys.modules["contracts_kit"]


class ForwardPolicy:
    """Always turns 'straight' (action 1 of the snake's Discrete(3))."""

    def act(self, obs: Array, rng: np.random.Generator) -> Array:
        return np.ones(len(obs), dtype=np.int64)


class TrippingLearner:
    """A Learner double whose `observe` raises `error` on its `at`-th transition."""

    def __init__(self, error: BaseException, at: int = FAIL_AT) -> None:
        self.error = error
        self.at = at
        self.observed = 0

    def act(self, obs: Array, rng: np.random.Generator) -> Array:
        return np.ones(len(obs), dtype=np.int64)

    def observe(self, t: Transition) -> None:
        self.observed += 1
        if self.observed == self.at:
            raise self.error

    def policy(self) -> ForwardPolicy:
        return ForwardPolicy()

    def state_dict(self) -> dict[str, object]:
        return {"observed": self.observed}


def _config(name: str) -> RunConfig:
    base: RunConfig = _kit().sample("core.RunConfig", "snake_default")
    return replace(base, name=name, budget=BUDGET)


def _folder(root: Path, config: RunConfig) -> Path:
    return root / config.world / config.variant / config.name


def _run(learner: TrippingLearner, config: RunConfig, root: Path) -> RunRecord:
    world = _kit().double("core.World", "snake_seed42")
    record: RunRecord = train_loop(world, {"snake": learner}, config, root)
    return record


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_nonfinite_stops_the_run_as_failed_at_step_700(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    learner = TrippingLearner(NonFiniteError(float("nan")))
    record = _run(learner, _config("snake-nonfinite"), tmp_path)
    assert record.status == "failed"
    assert record.failure is not None
    assert record.failure.step == FAIL_AT
    assert math.isnan(record.failure.value)
    assert record.ended is not None


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_nonfinite_stops_at_once_without_further_updates(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    learner = TrippingLearner(NonFiniteError(float("nan")))
    _run(learner, _config("snake-nonfinite-stop"), tmp_path)
    assert learner.observed == FAIL_AT


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_nonfinite_keeps_the_600_step_checkpoint(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    config = _config("snake-nonfinite-ckpt")
    learner = TrippingLearner(NonFiniteError(float("nan")))
    record = _run(learner, config, tmp_path)
    checkpoints = _folder(tmp_path, config) / "checkpoints"
    assert record.failure is not None
    assert record.failure.checkpoint.name == LAST_GOOD
    assert (checkpoints / LAST_GOOD).is_file()
    assert sorted(p.name for p in checkpoints.iterdir()) == ["ckpt_0.pt", LAST_GOOD]


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_nonfinite_failure_is_written_to_run_json(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    config = _config("snake-nonfinite-log")
    _run(TrippingLearner(NonFiniteError(float("nan"))), config, tmp_path)
    saved = json.loads((_folder(tmp_path, config) / "run.json").read_text())
    assert saved["status"] == "failed"
    assert saved["failure"]["step"] == FAIL_AT
    assert math.isnan(float(saved["failure"]["value"]))
    assert Path(saved["failure"]["checkpoint"]).name == LAST_GOOD


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_nonfinite_interrupted_run_is_marked_incomplete(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    config = _config("snake-interrupted")
    with contextlib.suppress(KeyboardInterrupt):
        _run(TrippingLearner(KeyboardInterrupt()), config, tmp_path)
    saved = json.loads((_folder(tmp_path, config) / "run.json").read_text())
    assert saved["status"] == "incomplete"
    assert saved["failure"] is None
